spans.s:
cāmara (IE 8-8), name of a coin; cf. cāmara-māda.
 (SII 3), a fly-whisk. See cauri, cavarālu.
cāmara , also called cāmara-māḍa; probably ‘a māḍa bearing the figure of a fly-whisk’; see māḍa.
Cāmara-kumāra, cf. Cavari-kumāra (EI 10), probably, a prince in charge of the fly-whisk which was one of the royal insignia.
cāmara-māḍa (EI 7), name of a coin; cf. cāmara.
Camūnāyaka (EI 27), a general; cf. Senāpati, etc.
Camūpa (IA 10), a general; same as Camūpati, etc.
Camūpati (EI 8-3); a general, same as Senāpati, etc.
